input.request: I want H&V to cancel my active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it cannot be used for future collections.

events.text: Direct Debit mandate: Northmere Fitness — Active.

summary: The request was for Harrow & Vale to cancel an active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it couldn't be used for future collections. The desk classed it as a Direct Debit instruction and tried to submit it directly, but that was refused because the requester's identity was not verified. It instead put a question to the recurring payments system about the Direct Debit and closed the case there. The mandate has not been cancelled, and the record shows no result from that system, so the outcome of the cancellation is still open.
